newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Q4 retail price index seen up 4.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: China's Q4 retail price index seen up 4.4 pct y/y.

text.p: China's retail price index is expected to rise 4.4 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with the same period of 1995, the Futures Herald said on Wednesday.
The price rise would compare with a year-on-year increase of 4.7 percent previously reported for October, said the report, prepared by the State Information Centre.
The retail price index was seen rising by 4.5 percent in November and 4.2 percent in December year-on-year.
Retail sales volumes were forecast to reach 229.2 billion yuan in November and 284 billion yuan in December, up 18.4 and 18.9 percent respectively from the same 1995 months.
Total retail sales volumes for 1996 were estimated to be up 19.3 percent, which would be a real increase of 12.4 percent taking inflation into account.
